evidence.quote: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。
evidence.value: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去%damage_echo_duration%秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。

context.description_en: Deals damage equal to a percentage of the target's Max Mana and burns part of it away. Deals additional damage equal to a percentage of the damage the target has taken from Nyx Assassin in the last %damage_echo_duration%s. Resets accumulated damage before applying damage.
context.description_zh: 造成等同于目标最大魔法值一定百分比的伤害，并燃烧部分魔法。另外还会根据过去%damage_echo_duration%秒内目标受到来自司夜刺客的伤害再造成一定百分比的伤害。施加伤害前会重置累计伤害。

evidence.quote: Warrior: Burns mana every hit, and deals magical damage to whoever kills it.

Summons a Warrior and an Archer to fight for you for 60 seconds.

Health: 800
Damage: 25

Last Will Damage: 600

Archer: Has a passive movement and attack speed aura. Gains Purge at Level 3.
Health: 800

context.lore: Considered the ultimate in necromancy and demonology, a powerful malefic force is locked within its pages.
